themes.summary: Microsoft committing $2.5b for Microsoft Frontier Co (6,000 AI/eng experts embedded at customers), two days after Amazon's $1b FDE investment, following Anthropic and OpenAI FDE affiliates already funded by PE. Sector total >=$8.5b committed in weeks.

Bending Spoons ($1.7b IPO, $18.4b valuation, Nasdaq: BSP) revitalizes distressed consumer brands (AOL, Vimeo, Eventbrite); founder says only ~10% of 1,000+ scouted targets are realistically buyable today but expects 90% buyable within 5-6 years.

Etched ($800m, stealth exit, $5b+ post), Together AI ($800m at $8.3b), Switch (in talks for $2b at $50b incl debt), Quantum Systems ($1.2b Series D at $8b) — capital concentrating in inference/cloud/defense-adjacent AI infra.

Comcast splitting into NBCUniversal (Cavanagh) and a leaner Comcast (Angelakis ex-Atairos), a tax-free spinoff; management denies it's prelude to M&A despite obvious consolidation logic (Charter/Cox closing, WBD/Paramount deal).
FlexWork Sports/ProCamps tie-up lands the same morning as a bipartisan House subcommittee hearing on regulating PE ownership of youth sports.

themes.theme: Q2 IPO window stayed open, PE megadeals cooled
themes.summary: 48 US IPOs raised $104.8b in Q2 (led by SpaceX) per Renaissance Capital, while PitchBook's first Q2 PE look flags a slowing megadeal pace and exits merely tracking 2025's rate.
